name: Word-per-shot sentence
description: A sentence builds word by word over footage or a still; one word is italic or a different weight.

recipe.build: SplitText words, stagger 0.12-0.2 s, one word font-style:italic; animate the container translateX to keep the line centred as words arrive.

use_when: Emotional lines over footage or a plate.
avoid: More than 9 words; do not run it over busy UI.

code.example: RasanMoves.wordPerShotSentence(tl, 0.2, { target: stage, words: ['Make','it','feel','like','you'], italicIndex: 4, image: photo });
